concept: IAM: aws:PrincipalOrgID condition to allow access from your organization
tests: Which condition key in a resource policy restricts calls to principals from a specific AWS Organization only.
expected: aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-xxxx in a resource-based policy. Triggers: "only from a particular AWS Organization", "resource policy".
why_not: aws:userid — a single principal; aws:SourceIp — a network address; lambda:FunctionArn describes the function, not the caller.
